role: Classifies a failed archive read or write as one that may clear soon (device locked, disk full, keychain refusing the key) or one that gives the same result next time, so launch scans stay unstamped only for the first kind.
state: static clearingCocoaCodes: Set<Int> = NSFileReadNoPermissionError, NSFileWriteNoPermissionError, NSFileWriteOutOfSpaceError

units.does: True when the error may clear on its own: the keychain refusing the key for now (JSONFileSeal.isKeyLocked), a Cocoa no-permission read/write or out-of-space error, or a POSIX EPERM/EACCES/ENOSPC error, itself or as the NSUnderlyingErrorKey of the error. False for everything else (hash mismatch, decrypt or decode failure, missing file or key, newer schema).

branches.cond: Cocoa domain and a clearing code
the error is a clearing POSIX error

branches.effect: false; else whether the underlying one is a clearing POSIX error

units.does: True for an NSError in the POSIX domain with code EPERM, EACCES or ENOSPC.
